about.title: About Crypto Tab
ui.automaticUpdates: Updates automatically while this tab is visible.
about.origin: Back in 2017, two friends got curious about Bitcoin.
about.wish: Crypto Tab came out of a simple wish - open a new tab, check the price, and get on with the day.
about.averagesExplanation: It’s made for vibe investors who want a feel for the bigger picture. Averaging prices over a day or month softens brief spikes and dips. That makes price trends easier to follow at a glance.
about.averagesExtremes: The longer views show daily averages (1W/1M) or monthly averages (1Y/ALL). Their highlighted highs and lows are averages too, so they can differ from an asset’s recorded price extremes.
about.history: First shipped in October 2017, maintained on and off ever since, and somehow grew organically to thousands of active installs! Now with dark mode, custom colors and finally an option to switch to Ether.
about.contactBefore: We’ve worked together for 10+ years, building browser extensions, wallets and Web3 dApps as the
about.contactAfter: team. Got a project? Let’s talk 🤝
